integrity: Analytical proof is primary evidence. The standalone Python verifier supplies finite numerical corroboration but is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The existence and eventual uniqueness of these nontrivial cycles is proved, but their dynamical stability is not classified.
Comparison with the motivating manuscript covers its introduction, construction, and early theory; later sections could not be retrieved during this review.
Unbounded-distance cycles under a small first-derivative perturbation do not mean curvature or all higher derivatives are uniformly negligible in the iteration.
Independent review and exhaustive historical-priority confirmation are outstanding.
title: Infinitely many distant two-cycles for a bounded Halley correction on nearly linear equations
